newsitem.title: USA: NAR economist - US existing home sales to fall in 97.
newsitem.headline: NAR economist - US existing home sales to fall in 97.

text.p: John Tuccillo of the National Association of Realtors on Friday said he expected to see a decline in existing home sales from 1996's record pace.
In remarks to reporters following release of January's 2.1 percent rise in existing home sales over December, NAR's chief economist said he expected a decline of 5.0 percent from 1996.
"Our forecast for 1997 is for about a 5.0 percent drop from 1996 to about 3.85 to 3.90 million homes." he said.
The association reported a revised total of 4.09 million existing single-family home sales for last year, up from the last record set in 1978 of 3.986 million units.
